_doc: HAND-EDIT. Campus rows the sources only give as a whole, dated at the first phase, are split by build_dc_delay.py into equal tranches on these dates. The ramp window is sourced where 'why' says so; the even split and the exact months are Capstone ESTIMATES. status_after_first overrides phase_status for tranches 2..n.

MI-SALINETWP-STARGATEMI-ALL.why: KBRA: staggered substantial completions Dec-2026 to Jan-2028
